description: Value grids and legal ranges for designPilot tunables in SG13G2. Keys: 'lib/cell', 'cell', or '*'. Values accept SI suffixes; null leaves a bound open. Limits follow the PDK techParams (sg13g2_tech.json min/max L, min W, max NG); total W is left open. A project-level designPilot.json in the project folder overrides these.
